idea.title: Brainless: Shadcn components that look like Claude Code, Codex and Grok

plan.tagline: Turn any Python CLI into a sleek AI assistant with Shadcn-inspired UI components
plan.problem: Developers waste hours building custom CLI UIs that look outdated, while AI tools like Claude Code set the visual standard but aren't accessible for local development
plan.solution: Provides pre-built Shadcn-style components (inputs, tables, cards) that mimic Claude Code's aesthetic, packaged as a Python CLI library. Users import components to build polished CLIs in minutes with zero frontend work
plan.target_market: Solo Python developers and indie hackers building internal tools, small businesses automating workflows, and remote teams needing professional-looking CLIs
mvp_features: Offline --demo mode with hardcoded AI assistant demo

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: sqlite schema for component storage + basic add/list commands

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: --demo mode with hardcoded AI assistant flow + docs

plan.demo_script: Run `claudecli --demo` to see a mock AI assistant CLI with Shadcn-styled input/output cards, markdown tables, and a chat interface - all 100% offline with hardcoded data
